name: Leotard Fairy ~Shoujo-tachi no Himitsu no Lesson~
original_name: レオタードフェアリー ～少女たちの秘密のレッスン～
source:
The male protagonist, Yahagi (a teacher of MEN's rhythmic gymnastics), is hired to help two troublesome FEMALE students who suddenly dropped a promising career in rhythmic gymnastics.
But this is an erogame, and therefore the only effective solution to the girls' problems is...
translation:
男主人公矢作（MEN艺术体操老师）受雇帮助两名突然放弃了前途光明的艺术体操职业的麻烦女学生。
但这是一款色情游戏，因此解决女孩们的问题唯一有效的办法就是……
